name: Flock Off
hook: Deflock the block. No face, no case.
tagline: A man in all black rides a BMX through Flockville shooting the licence-plate cameras off their poles: aim with the pointer or the keys while the game rides the bike, keep a streak, dodge the reads, and get in the Kia before the police catch him. The crash is the bust: a PIT, a spike strip, a hedge cop, a taser or a Flock drone with a net, then the mugshot.
